note: Draft Ebi designs for the asset viewer only. Nothing in the app uses these files.

candidates.description: The current Ebi traced line for line, with a gentle rim of light along its back.
The current Ebi traced line for line, with a soft glossy streak on the shell and a crisp catchlight in the eye.
The current Ebi traced line for line, with a soft inner shadow under the arch and along the tail.
The current Ebi traced line for line, in a slightly warmer, brighter red that reads well on light and dark.
The current Ebi traced line for line, with a whisper of light on top and shade below for gentle volume.
An original chunky shrimp: a big round head, bold banded shell, thick curly antennae, round leg nubs and a two lobe tail.
An original slim shrimp: a long elegant curl, chevron segment lines, long whip antennae, slender legs and a three blade tail.
An original plump shrimp: a tall rounded back, a coral belly stripe, little bobble antennae, tiny feet and a heart shaped tail.
An original geometric shrimp: a straight head into a perfect round arch, ridged back, raised antennae, a friendly brow and a forked tail.
An original lively shrimp: a little nose spike, one bright stripe down the back, crossed antennae, hooked legs and a fan tail.
An original hand drawn shrimp: a small round head under a heavy humped back, a springy tail with a two lobe fan, and poses that act out every mood.
An original hand drawn shrimp: a big round head with a large eye, a body that sweeps back and hooks under into a flicked fan.
An original hand drawn shrimp standing tall like a question mark: head on top, back down the side and the tail tucked forward.
An original hand drawn shrimp curled into a round ball, with a coral belly, short curly antennae and a fan peeking out below.
An original hand drawn shrimp with a big helmet shell over the head and a separate plated tail curling down to a wide fan.
The current Ebi, polished: the same flat crimson arch, dot eye and long antennae, with crisper curves, one soft shade, one light band and neat notches.
The classic, redrawn with smooth curves: a chunkier arch that swells at the back, a rounder nose, a shiny eye, a tidy forked tail fan and one curved seam where the tail turns darker.
The refined Ebi in two tones: a soft coral belly band and coral legs under the crimson shell, like a cooked shrimp.
The refined Ebi with a bigger head: a big sparkly eye with two catchlights, a pink blush and a slightly shorter tail, still the same clean shapes.
A slimmer, elegant Ebi: a lighter body, a longer forked tail fan and long antennae that end in a curl.
The refined Ebi in flat sunset bands: a deep crimson back, a warm red middle and a coral belly, no gradients.
The current Ebi, a little rounder: a bigger head, a plumper body, a softer tail and a shiny eye with two highlights.
The current Ebi, more elegant: a slimmer arch, fine thin antennae and a sharper tail.
The current Ebi, softer: a gentle darker edge, two tone shading and a light blush.
The current Ebi, bolder: thicker shapes and a strong deep red outline, like a sticker without the white border.
The current Ebi with a candy lacquer: a bright glossy streak along the back, a shine on the head and a gleam on the tail.
The current Ebi in warm ink: a thin warm brown outline, a brown eye and mouth and a light blush.
The current Ebi on tiny legs: five little jointed walking legs and a small claw under the chin.
The current Ebi, more expressive: a bigger eye with two catchlights, an eyebrow for every mood and a larger mouth.
The current Ebi with shell segments: curved bands across the body and a flat two tone cel shade.
Rounder and cuter: a big head, big shiny eyes, rosy cheeks and a shorter curl.
A longer curve with more shrimp detail: shell plates, a small rostrum spike and a three lobed tail fan.
The classic Ebi as a sticker: a white sticker border and a soft dark outline.
Tiny chibi: a huge round head and a little curled body, eyes you can read at any size.
Round mochi: a soft bean shaped shrimp with a stubby tail, all squish and no corners.
Tall question mark pose: Ebi stands up on a curled tail, head high and proud.
Long tail: a slim body that sweeps into a big spiral tail, elegant and fast.
Mascot logo: a heavy navy outline, ringed eyes and a determined brow, like a team badge.
Minimal geometric: built from straight facets and triangles, a clean modern icon.
Cel shaded game style: a slim body, a thin dark line, a hard highlight on the back and a deep belly shadow.
Pixel art: Ebi as a chunky retro game sprite, square pixels and a dark outline.
Watercolor: soft washes that bleed past a loose pencil line, like a painted card.
Kawaii sticker: a fat comma curl, shiny bean eyes, a cat mouth and little sparkles.
Plush toy: soft fabric Ebi with stitched seams, button eyes and a little sewn in tag.
Retro 90s anime: thick ink lines, huge sparkly eyes and bold cel shading.
Storybook: a gentle hand drawn line, a cream belly and soft speckles, like a picture book.
Tempura Ebi: a golden crunchy batter body with a bright red tail, cute enough to not eat.
Chef Ebi: a tall white toque and a neckerchief, ready to run the kitchen.
Deep sea explorer: Ebi in a glass diving dome with a brass collar and bubbles.
Line icon: one even red line over a pale fill, crisp like an app icon.
Paper cut: layered paper bands with a drop shadow, like a craft collage.
Gummy candy: a glossy see through jelly Ebi with bright shine spots.
Ink print: a red shape with a slightly offset black brush line and a seal, like a Japanese woodblock.
